# prism_org_policies_for_target (Data Source)

Lists AWS Organizations policies attached to a specific target (root, OU, or account) through CloudKeeper Prism.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all SCPs attached to a specific OU
data "prism_org_policies_for_target" "ou_scps" {
  target_id             = "ou-abc1-exampleou"
  policy_type           = "SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY"
}

# List all tag policies attached to a specific account
data "prism_org_policies_for_target" "account_tags" {
  target_id             = "987654321098"
  policy_type           = "TAG_POLICY"
}

output "ou_scp_count" {
  value = length(data.prism_org_policies_for_target.ou_scps.policies)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `target_id` (String) The ID of the root, organizational unit, or account to list policies for

### Optional

- `policy_type` (String) The type of policy to filter by. Defaults to SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY if not specified. Valid values: `SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY`, `TAG_POLICY`, `BACKUP_POLICY`, `AISERVICES_OPT_OUT_POLICY`, `RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY`.

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) List of policies attached to the target (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `aws_managed` (Boolean) Whether the policy is an AWS-managed policy
- `description` (String) A description of the policy
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the policy
- `name` (String) The friendly name of the policy
- `type` (String) The type of policy
